new_findings.text: Persona prompts significantly enhance jailbreak effectiveness against LLMs, reducing refusal rates by 50-70% and showing synergy with existing attack methods (+10-20% success rate).
new_findings.evidence: Genetic algorithm-based persona prompts reduce refusal rates by 50-70% across multiple LLMs; combined with existing attacks, increase success rates by 10-20%.

new_findings.text: Prompt injection detection can be approached via supervised classifiers trained on curated/augmented HackAPrompt dataset, using LSTM, FFNN, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes.
new_findings.evidence: Curated and augmented prompt injection dataset based on HackAPrompt Playground Submissions; trained multiple classifiers for malicious prompt detection in LLM-integrated applications.

new_findings.text: AgentGuard framework autonomously discovers and validates unsafe tool-use workflows in agentic systems, then generates safety guardrails for tool orchestration.
new_findings.evidence: Proposes AgentGuard to autonomously discover/validate unsafe tool-use workflows and generate safety guardrails, addressing consequential impact of compromised agents with tool-use capability.

new_findings.text: Foundation model transparency deteriorated in 2025 (average score 58→40), with companies most opaque about training data, compute, and post-deployment usage/impact.
new_findings.evidence: 2025 FMTI shows average transparency score fell from 58 (2024) to 40 (2025); companies most opaque about training data, training compute, and post-deployment usage/impact of flagship models.
